name: Greater Impede Movement (Combat)
body:
You are skilled at hindering your opponent’s movement.

Prerequisite(s): Combat Expertise, Improved Impede Movement; base attack bonus +12, Int 13.

Benefit(s): You receive a +2 bonus to your Combat Maneuver Bonus when performing this combat maneuver against a foe. This bonus stacks with the bonus granted by Improved Impede Movement. In addition, you deal full damage to the creature rather than half damage.
